title: Compatibility under extension
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho,\eta$ be coordinate restrictions. Suppose $T$ is compatible with $\rho$, every coordinate appearing in a literal of $T$ is fixed by $\rho$, and $\eta$ agrees with $\rho$ at every coordinate where $\rho$ is not free. Then $T$ is compatible with $\eta$.
